title: Man Gets Tased After Attacking Homeless Man
description:
Man Gets Tased By Police After Robbing Homeless Man

A 35-year-old man faces a charge of armed robbery and other counts as a repeat offender in connection with an assault of a homeless individual in Cameron Park in downtown La Crosse, WI, and theft of the man’s jacket.
